decisive_items: dilation of the duodenum and proximal jejunum
vomitus included stomach contents and bile
response.rationale: Imaging shows proximal small bowel dilation with spring sign and duodenal/jejunal dilation, classic for small bowel obstruction; free gas may be secondary but not primary. R2C is more specific than R2.

rejected.why: No fistula tract or contrast extravasation; free gas and obstruction better explained by SBO.
Free gas present but no clear perforation site; obstruction findings dominate.
Prior bariatric surgery raises hernia risk, but no hernia sac or closed-loop evidence.
Spring sign alone insufficient; no ischemic markers or bowel wall pneumatosis.
Tenderness and bowel sounds nonspecific; no band identified.
Weight loss and pain nonspecific; no ischemia-specific imaging.
No chronic inflammatory features or mucosal changes.
